integrity_notes: All infinite statements have analytic arguments: endpoint blocking and Borel-Cantelli, de Finetti representation, positive-mass finite center cover. Fraction arithmetic checks in verify_examples.py are ancillary only.
limitations: Classifies infinitely exchangeable bilateral-shift measures, not all stationary dependent measures. The critical radius for a nontrivial mixture may or may not be expansive; sharp numerical radius is specific to the stated weighted metric.
title: Sharp expansivity radius and exchangeable-mixture criterion for the Hilbert-cube shift
